payload.friendly_name: Second clones reconcile with origin before every terminus gate
payload.purpose_context: In a two-person team each person works in their own clone. Today review, accept and consolidate trust the clone's local branches and never look at what teammates pushed, so a rejected work package can land as done and a reviewed fix can be dropped, with exit 0. A second clone also never gets the merge-driver settings, so its first pull corrupts mission files. This mission adds one origin check every terminus gate passes through, and makes init and upgrade install the clone-local settings.
payload.purpose_tldr: A teammate's clone checks origin before review, accept and consolidate trust its local copy, so a pushed rejection or fix is never silently ignored.

payload.question: When a terminus gate finds origin ahead of the local view, what should it do?
When a remote is configured but unreachable at a terminus gate, what happens?

payload.final_answer: Fail closed + opt-out, with an env variable to default opt-out of remote/local enforcement

payload.wp_title: init / upgrade install clone-local merge drivers (#5759)
consolidate refuses on stale evidence and lanes (#5780)
Drain every remote contact into the owner; census gate
Kernel: one owner of remote contact
review prepares the lane from the remote (#5758)
